samples.question: A set of small, dark, isolated dots sits on a white canvas. None of the dots touch and no line connects them; the dots are spaced closely enough that each dot clearly belongs next to its nearest neighbours. Read the dots as one single continuous contour traced by their proximity. Does that contour close into one closed loop (every dot lies on the unbroken cycle) or stay as one open chain (a single path with exactly two free ends)? Choose from: one closed loop, one open chain.
